title: Cheat Sheet - DLL API
markdown:
## Building and exporting

```cpp-norun
// One header for the DLL and its users (the DLL project defines MYLIB_EXPORTS)
#if defined(MYLIB_STATIC)
#define MYLIB_API
#elif defined(MYLIB_EXPORTS)
#define MYLIB_API __declspec(dllexport)
#else
#define MYLIB_API __declspec(dllimport)
#endif

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif
MYLIB_API int32_t mylib_thing_create(mylib_thing** out);
MYLIB_API void    mylib_thing_destroy(mylib_thing* thing);
#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

```
LIBRARY   MyLib                ; a .def file
EXPORTS
    mylib_thing_create   @1
    mylib_thing_destroy  @2
    PublicName = internal_name
    hidden_entry         @9 NONAME
```

## Loading at run time

| Function | Use |
|---|---|
| `LoadLibraryW(path)` | Map a DLL; `NULL` on failure, see `GetLastError()` |
| `LoadLibraryExW(path, nullptr, flags)` | The same, with search flags or as a data file |
| `GetProcAddress(module, "name")` | An export's address (`FARPROC`); cast to the exact function type |
| `FreeLibrary(module)` | Drop one reference |
| `GetModuleHandleW(L"name.dll")` | Handle of an already-loaded module, no new reference |
| `GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, buf, n)` | Full path of your own `.exe` |
| `SetDefaultDllDirectories(LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_DEFAULT_DIRS)` | First line of `main`: no current directory or PATH in searches |
| `AddDllDirectory(folder)` | Add a folder to `LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_USER_DIRS` |

| Flag | Searches |
|---|---|
| `LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_DLL_LOAD_DIR` | The loaded DLL's own folder (full paths only) |
| `LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_APPLICATION_DIR` | The `.exe`'s folder |
| `LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_USER_DIRS` | Folders from `AddDllDirectory` |
| `LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32` | `System32` |
| `LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_DEFAULT_DIRS` | Application, user folders, System32 |
| `LOAD_LIBRARY_AS_DATAFILE` | Map for resources only; no code runs |

## Error codes from LoadLibrary

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 126 `ERROR_MOD_NOT_FOUND` | The DLL or one of its dependencies was not found |
| 127 `ERROR_PROC_NOT_FOUND` | A dependency lacks an export that is imported |
| 193 `ERROR_BAD_EXE_FORMAT` | Wrong architecture (32/64-bit) or not a PE file |
| 1114 `ERROR_DLL_INIT_FAILED` | `DllMain` returned `FALSE` |

## The standard search order (name-only requests)

Already loaded, then known DLLs, then: application folder, `System32`, `System`, `Windows`, current directory, PATH.

## DllMain

```cpp-norun
BOOL APIENTRY DllMain(HMODULE module, DWORD reason, LPVOID reserved)
{
    if (reason == DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH) DisableThreadLibraryCalls(module);
    return TRUE;
}
```

Safe: set variables, `DisableThreadLibraryCalls`, `InitializeCriticalSection`, `TlsAlloc`. Not safe: `LoadLibrary`, `FreeLibrary`, waiting for threads or locks, COM, sockets, registry, UI. Do real work in an explicit init function.

## Rules at the boundary

- Whoever allocates, frees: free functions, caller buffers, or create/destroy pairs.
- No exceptions out of exported functions: catch everything, return codes.
- No C++ library types in a public interface; pointer and length instead.
- Fixed-size types (`int32_t`, `uint64_t`), no `bool` or `long` in C interfaces.
- Result codes never renumbered; callers treat unknown nonzero codes as failure.
- Visible structs start with their size and only grow at the end.

## Tools

| Command | Shows |
|---|---|
| `dumpbin /exports X.dll` | Export table |
| `dumpbin /imports X.exe` | Imported DLLs and functions |
| `dumpbin /dependents X.exe` | Directly needed DLLs |
| `dumpbin /headers X.dll` | Machine type, base, characteristics |
| `undname ?name@@...` | Decodes a decorated C++ name |
| Debug, Windows, Modules | Every loaded module, its path and address |
| Process Monitor | Every place Windows looked for a file |
